sources.text: Project baseline: customer onboarding release was due 2026-10-15; approved scope includes identity integration, migration, and staff training.
Delivery update: identity integration passed staging on 2026-10-12; migration rehearsal completed for 70% of records; staff training attendance is not attached.
Dependency note: production credential approval remains pending with the customer security team; no signed acceptance or revised launch date is supplied.
